ns2:course.label: Tax Policy and Finan Planning
ns2:course.description: Explores the federal tax system, including income, social security, Medicare, and estate taxes, and state and local tax systems. Students learn basic tax principles, public policy issues embedded in the tax systems, and how tax law influences financial plans and decisions. Helps students make wiser financial decisions through increased understanding of the tax impacts of those decisions, participate knowledgeably in public debates surrounding tax policy, and prepare for careers as financial planners. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr, Consumer, & Env Sciences. Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Agr & Consumer Economics department.
